description: Every check that needs real GPU hardware or GPU-stage infrastructure, plus optional checks that need external accounts or local services. A test may skip in CPU-stage runs only if its skip reason matches an entry here (see scripts/verify/skip_audit.py). GPU-stage checks run only after explicit approval, via .github/workflows/gpu-stage.yml.

gpu_stage.reason: Starts the full release Compose topology, including the three GPU services that request 'gpus: all'; requires a self-hosted GPU runner.
Reads real nvidia-smi and Docker GPU runtime metadata. CPU-stage tests cover its parsing with simulated command output only.
Smoke-tests real visual/transcription inference on the GPU inference worker image.
Smoke-tests real MediaPipe matte segmentation on the matte GPU worker image.
Renders with the h264_nvenc hardware encoder and inspects codec evidence.

optional.reason: Calls real remote provider accounts (planning, transcription and stock video); outside the CPU-stage proof.
Needs a live Redis; always enabled by the 'contracts' verify stage and the redis-contracts CI job.
Needs a local Supabase stack; always enabled by the 'db' verify stage and the empty-database CI job.
Downloads and runs the Temporal SDK test server; always enabled by the 'contracts' verify stage.
Real Remotion + Chromium + ffmpeg encode; always enabled by the 'media' verify stage.
Real Remotion frame-signature goldens in the pinned renderer image; enabled by the 'media' verify stage.
Runs the pinned cfn-lint and cfn-guard binaries (scripts/aws/install-tools.sh); always enabled by the 'aws' verify stage.
